title: Custom eggless cake pickup in Rosehill and Camellia — open until 10pm
summary:
Most bakeries near Rosehill and Camellia stop taking custom pickups well before dinner. Harris Park doesn't.

Num Nums stays open until 10pm, seven days a week — which is why a custom eggless cake for a Camellia gathering or a Rosehill birthday doesn't have to be collected on someone else's schedule. Six sizes, 15 flavours, buttercream, fondant or ganache. 100% eggless, every single cake, no exceptions.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes. Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati too.
